refinements.name: 时喰奇谋
refinements.description:
装备者的电属性异常积蓄效率提升30%；[特殊技]或[强化特殊技]命中处于属性异常状态下的敌人时，装备者的异常精通提升75点，持续15秒；
当装备者的异常精通大于等于375点时，由装备者造成的[紊乱]伤害提升25%。
refinements.descriptionEn:
The equipper's Electric Anomaly Buildup Rate increases by 30%. When Special Attacks or EX Special Attacks hit enemies suffering an Attribute Anomaly, the equipper's Anomaly Proficiency increases by 75 for 15s.
When the equipper's Anomaly Proficiency is greater than or equal to 375, Disorder DMG inflicted by the equipper increases by 25%.

basic.name: 普通攻击：夜见尊神乐
basic.trigger: 点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
basic.description:
月城柳拥有[上弦]和[下弦]两种架势；
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
根据当前架势，向前方进行至多五段的斩击，造成物理伤害和电属性伤害；
在战斗中，月城柳可根据当前架势类型获得对应的架势增益：
[上弦]架势增益：自身造成的电属性伤害提升10%，[普通攻击]发动期间抗打断等级提升；
[下弦]架势增益：自身穿透率提升10%，[普通攻击]的打断等级提升；
架势切换后，月城柳仍可继续保有上一架势的架势增益，持续8秒。
basic.descriptionEn:
Yanagi has two stances: Jougen and Kagen.
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Execute up to five forward slashes based on the current stance, causing Physical DMG and Electric DMG.
During combat, Yanagi gains the corresponding stance buff based on her current stance:
Jougen stance buff: Electric DMG increases by 10%. Anti-Interrupt Level increases during Basic Attacks.
Kagen stance buff: PEN Ratio increases by 10%. Interrupt Level increases for Basic Attacks.
For 8s after switching stances, Yanagi retains the bonus from the previous stance.

special.name: 特殊技：流转
special.trigger: 点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
special.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
向前方进行斩击，造成电属性伤害，并切换当前架势；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升；
若衔接在[普通攻击]第三、四、五段之后发动，则能够触发[快速流转]，以更快的速度进行斩击并切换当前架势；
[快速流转]发动期间可以格挡敌人的攻击；
触发[快速流转]后，可以直接衔接当前架势下第三段[普通攻击]。
special.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Perform a forward slash, dealing Electric DMG, and switch the current stance.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.
If activated after the 3rd, 4th, or 5th hit of a Basic Attack, it activates Swift Ruten, speeding up the slashes while switching her current stance.
Block enemy attacks while Swift Ruten is active.
Upon activating Swift Ruten, Yanagi can immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of the current stance's Basic Attack.

ex.name: 强化特殊技：月华流转
ex.trigger: 能量足够时，长按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
ex.triggerEn: With enough Energy, hold [EX Special Attack] to activate:
ex.description:
能量足够时，长按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
积蓄力量向前快速突刺，随后发动下落攻击，造成大量电属性伤害；
突刺发动时，月城柳会切换当前架势，并进入[森罗万象]状态，持续15秒，状态持续期间，从[普通攻击]第五段或其他招式衔接后继[普通攻击]时，将直接从第三段[普通攻击] 起手；
下落攻击命中处于属性异常状态下的敌人时，将会触发特殊的[紊乱]效果[极性紊乱]，对目标造成原本[紊乱]效果15%的伤害，并额外附加月城柳725%异常精通的伤害，[极性紊乱]不会清除目标所处的属性异常状态；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ex.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, hold [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Charge up power for a quick forward thrust, followed by a downward attack, dealing massive Electric DMG.
Upon executing the thrust, Yanagi switches stances and enters the Shinrabanshou state, lasting 15s. For the duration of this state, when following up with a subsequent Basic Attack from the 5th hit of a Basic Attack or other skills, the combo will begin directly from the 3rd hit of the Basic Attack.
If the downward attack hits an enemy suffering an Anomaly, it triggers a special Disorder effect, Polarity Disorder, dealing 15% of the original Disorder effect's DMG to the target, plus an additional 725% of Yanagi's Anomaly Proficiency. Polarity Disorder will not remove the target's Anomaly.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

dodgeCounter.name: 闪避反击：疾反
dodgeCounter.trigger: 触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
dodgeCounter.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
dodgeCounter.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动斩击，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
招式发动后，可以直接衔接当前架势下第三段[普通攻击]。
dodgeCounter.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Slashes enemies in front, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After using this skill, you can immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of the current stance's Basic Attack.

chain.name: 连携技：星月相随
chain.trigger: 触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
chain.triggerEn: When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
chain.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
切换当前架势，并对前方敌人发动强力斩击，造成大量电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
招式发动后，可以直接衔接当前架势下第三段[普通攻击]。
chain.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Switch stances and unleash a powerful slash on enemies in front, dealing massive Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After using this skill, you can immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of the current stance's Basic Attack.

ultimate.name: 终结技：雷影天华
ultimate.trigger: 喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
ultimate.triggerEn: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
ultimate.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
激发自身能力，在极短时间内对前方大范围敌人发动强力斩击，并追加落雷攻击，造成大量电属性伤害；
落雷攻击命中处于属性异常状态下的敌人时，将会触发特殊的[紊乱]效果[极性紊乱]，对目标造成原本[紊乱]效果15%的伤害，并额外附加月城柳725%异常精通的伤害，[极性紊乱]不会清除目标所处的属性异常状态；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
招式发动后，可以直接衔接当前架势下第三段[普通攻击]。
ultimate.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Yanagi unleashes her potential and delivers a powerful slash to a large area of enemies in front in a very short time, followed by an additional lightning strike, dealing massive Electric DMG.
When the lightning strike hits an enemy affected by an Attribute Anomaly, it triggers a special Disorder effect called Polarity Disorder. This deals DMG equal to 15% of the original Disorder effect plus an additional 725% of Yanagi's Anomaly Proficiency. Polarity Disorder will not remove the target's Anomaly.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After using this skill, Yanagi can immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of the current stance's Basic Attack.

quickAssist.name: 快速支援：风华斩
quickAssist.trigger: 当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
quickAssist.triggerEn: When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
quickAssist.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动斩击，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
招式发动后，可以直接衔接当前架势下第三段[普通攻击]。
quickAssist.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Slashes enemies in front, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After using this skill, you can immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of the current stance's Basic Attack.

defensiveAssist.name: 招架支援：流光反
defensiveAssist.trigger: 前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
defensiveAssist.triggerEn: When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
defensiveAssist.description:
前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
招架敌人的攻击，累积大量失衡值；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
defensiveAssist.descriptionEn:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

assistFollowup.name: 支援突击：飞絮刺
assistFollowup.trigger: 发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
assistFollowup.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
assistFollowup.description:
发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
切换当前架势，对前方敌人快速发动多段斩击，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
招式发动后，可以直接衔接当前架势下第三段[普通攻击]。
assistFollowup.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Switch stances, and quickly deliver multiple slashes to enemies in front, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After using this skill, you can immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of the current stance's Basic Attack.

facts.text: 月城柳发动[强化特殊技]后，队伍中任意角色对敌人施加[紊乱]效果时，[紊乱]效果的伤害倍率提升250%，持续15秒；[强化特殊技]命中敌人时，月城柳对目标造成的电属性伤害提升20%，持续15秒。
facts.textEn:
After Yanagi activates her EX Special Attack, the DMG multiplier of Disorder is increased by 250% when any squad member applies the Disorder effect to an enemy, lasting 15s.
When her EX Special Attack hits an enemy, Yanagi's Electric DMG against the target is increased by 20% for 15s.

cinema.name: 知己知彼
cinema.nameEn: Know Thy Self, Know Thy Enemy
cinema.description: 队伍中任意角色对敌人施加属性异常效果时，月城柳会获得1层[洞悉]，持续15秒，最多叠加3层，重复触发时刷新持续时间；受到敌方攻击时，月城柳将消耗1层[洞悉]并获得无敌效果，持续1秒；拥有1层或以上[洞悉]时，月城柳的异常精通提升80点。
cinema.descriptionEn: When any squad member inflicts an Anomaly on an enemy, Yanagi gains 1 stack of Clarity, lasting 15s, stacking up to 3 times. Repeated triggers reset the duration. Upon being hit by an enemy attack, Yanagi consumes 1 stack of Clarity to gain invulnerability for 1s. When Yanagi has 1 or more stacks of Clarity, her Anomaly Proficiency increases by 80.

cinema.name: 卓越适应性
cinema.description: [强化特殊技]中，快速突刺累积的电属性异常积蓄值提升20%；快速突刺命中敌人时，保持长按「特殊攻击」按键，可以额外消耗10点能量，再次发动突刺攻击，能量不足或停止长按后将自动衔接下落攻击；下落攻击命中处于属性异常状态下的敌人并触发[极性紊乱]效果时，对目标造成的伤害倍率提升至原本[紊乱]效果的20%，每额外发动一次突刺攻击，该伤害倍率额外提升15%，伤害倍率额外提升效果最多触发2次。
cinema.descriptionEn: During her EX Special Attack, the rapid thrust's Electric Anomaly Buildup increases by 20%. Holding down the Special Attack button after a rapid thrust hits an enemy will consume 10 additional Energy to launch another thrust. If Energy is insufficient or the button is released, the attack automatically follows up with the downward attack. When the downward attack hits an enemy suffering an Anomaly and triggers Polarity Disorder, the DMG multiplier increases to 20% of the original Disorder effect. Each additional thrust increases this multiplier by 15%, up to a maximum of 2 extra thrusts.

cinema.name: 月城氏管理学
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cinema.name: 掌棋者
cinema.description: 月城柳对敌人造成属性异常伤害时，会为其施加[识破]效果，持续15秒；处于[识破]效果下的敌人受到攻击时，本次攻击的穿透率提升16%。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Yanagi inflicts Attribute Anomaly DMG on an enemy, they suffer the Exposed effect, lasting 15s. Attacks on enemies under the Expose effect will have 16% increased PEN Ratio.

cinema.name: 鬼「妈妈」
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cinema.name: 非人之血
cinema.description: 在[强化特殊技]中发动突刺攻击后，[森罗万象]状态的持续时间提升至30秒，状态持续期间，[强化特殊技]造成的伤害提升20%；[卓越适应性]中，[极性紊乱]伤害倍率额外提升效果的触发次数上限提升至4次，前4次额外发动突刺攻击时所需的能量消耗减半。
cinema.descriptionEn: After a thrust attack during her EX Special Attack, the duration of the Shinrabanshou state increases to 30s. While the state is active, EX Special Attack DMG increases by 20%. The maximum number of times the additional DMG multiplier increase effect for Polarity Disorder in Outstanding Adaptability can be triggered increases to 4, and the Energy cost for the first 4 additional thrust attacks is halved.

gold.name: 柳
notes: 曾为限定UP，现为定制调频候选；本功能按原生限定口径计1，不称为开服常驻，也不推断账号获取时是否为UP。

Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Perform a forward slash, dealing Electric DMG, and switch the current stance.

Block enemy attacks while Swift Ruten is active.
Upon activating Swift Ruten, Yanagi can immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of the current stance's Basic Attack.

ex.name: 强化特殊技：月华流转
ex.description:
能量足够时，长按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
积蓄力量向前快速突刺，随后发动下落攻击，造成大量电属性伤害；
突刺发动时，月城柳会切换当前架势，并进入[森罗万象]状态，持续15秒，状态持续期间，从[普通攻击]第五段或其他招式衔接后继[普通攻击]时，将直接从第三段[普通攻击] 起手；
下落攻击命中处于属性异常状态下的敌人时，将会触发特殊的[紊乱]效果[极性紊乱]，对目标造成原本[紊乱]效果15%的伤害，并额外附加月城柳725%异常精通的伤害，[极性紊乱]不会清除目标所处的属性异常状态；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ex.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, hold [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Charge up power for a quick forward thrust, followed by a downward attack, dealing massive Electric DMG.
Upon executing the thrust, Yanagi switches stances and enters the Shinrabanshou state, lasting 15s. For the duration of this state, when following up with a subsequent Basic Attack from the 5th hit of a Basic Attack or other skills, the combo will begin directly from the 3rd hit of the Basic Attack.
If the downward attack hits an enemy suffering an Anomaly, it triggers a special Disorder effect, Polarity Disorder, dealing 15% of the original Disorder effect's DMG to the target, plus an additional 725% of Yanagi's Anomaly Proficiency. Polarity Disorder will not remove the target's Anomaly.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
招式发动后，可以直接衔接当前架势下第三段[普通攻击]。
